sourceSet.rule: Current-adult identity is resolved from multiple real sources. No single generated reference may override real-source consensus.

filenameReconciliation.rule: Do not alias these filenames unless original-byte provenance proves they are the same source.

historical.rule: Never substitute historical Adam for current-adult launch identity.

generatedDerived.rule: No generated or reconstructed result can supersede real-source identity authority without literal comparison, provenance, and human approval.

identityRules: Do not beautify or genericize the subject.
Preserve visible asymmetry and distinguishing features.
Do not invent tattoo detail beyond visible evidence.
Do not infer biometric identity from unrelated images.
Do not expose private source media in public GitHub or client bundles.
All derivatives must retain source hash lineage and synthetic/real classification.

presentationAuthority.description: Represent Adam as the same mature current-adult person in the project-approved rested presentation direction: approximately 20 lb leaner in presentation, upright, realistic and naturally asymmetric. This is art-direction authority, not a statement of current measured weight or health.
stableIdentityMustPreserve: glasses when part of intended launch appearance
tattoos supported by real source evidence
body proportions supported by multi-source real evidence
bodyPresentationRules: Preserve real skeletal build and identity-defining proportions.
Use the project-approved approximately 20 lb leaner/rested presentation direction without turning Adam into a bodybuilder, superhero, tiny-waist fitness model, or younger replacement.
Moderately reduce abdomen/flank presentation and superficial facial puffiness only as presentation direction, while preserving skull, jaw/chin identity, neck proportions and general skeletal build.
Reject wide-angle distortion, slouching, clothing bunching and temporary puffiness as canonical geometry evidence.
Resolve final scale and lower-body proportions from real full-body evidence and measurements when supplied.
presentationAuthority.captureTimingRule: A tired-day capture may be retained as provenance but must not define canonical rested-neutral presentation. New identity capture can wait until Adam is rested enough to represent the intended launch appearance.
